cases.title: Cross-Border SEPA & ACH Batch Clearing Platform
cases.prompt_text:
Context: Our retail banking platform clears 400,000 daily cross-border SEPA and domestic ACH payouts across 14 correspondent banks. Recent outages caused duplicate debit postings when partner gateways timed out during cutoff windows.

Functional & NFR Scope: We need a deterministic clearing state machine backed by an append-only ledger database that guarantees exactly-once settlement per payment instruction, encrypts all IBAN/routing payloads at rest with AES-256, and enforces 99.95% availability during clearing windows.

Operational & Readiness Constraints: Sanctions false-positive holds above $10,000 cannot be auto-cleared by software; compliance officers must execute the quarterly sanctions review SOP and record written disposition rationales. All regional clearing coordinators must pass an annual AML sanctions refresher training and simulation assessment before receiving override credentials.
gold_requirements: R1: The clearing state machine service shall guarantee exactly-once settlement semantics and persist encrypted IBAN payloads in an append-only ledger database.
R2: Compliance officers shall execute the documented sanctions disposition SOP and manual audit review for every held transfer exceeding $10,000.
R3: Regional clearing coordinators must complete the annual AML sanctions refresher training curriculum and pass a competency assessment before credential issuance.
R4: The platform shall provide an automated sanctions screening API integrated with a human compliance officer escalation queue for ambiguous name matches.
adr_rubric_anchors: Justify Functional Core state machine isolation for exactly-once clearing invariants and Alloy verification scope.
Document regulatory liability reasons for rejecting automated sanctions false-positive clearance.
Bind go-live cutover to completed AML refresher training certification and documented compliance SOP.

cases.title: Card Dispute & Chargeback Representment Hub
cases.prompt_text:
Background: Merchant acquiring teams handle 18,000 monthly cardholder chargebacks under strict Visa and Mastercard representment deadlines. Missed evidence submission windows cost $1.4M annually in automatic write-offs.

System Expectations: Build an automated evidence-intake API and deadline-tracking queue that ingests card network reason codes, validates PDF receipt schemas, and alerts merchants 72 hours prior to network cutoff.

Socio-Technical Boundaries: High-value friendly-fraud disputes over $25,000 require manual review and written approval from the merchant risk governance committee before representment filing. New dispute specialists struggle with network reason-code taxonomy, so we need structured coaching workshops and a role-based user guide with proficiency checks prior to independent case handling.
gold_requirements: R1: The dispute intake service shall validate evidence schemas, persist case deadlines in the database, and dispatch automated webhook alerts 72 hours before network cutoffs.
R2: Friendly-fraud representments exceeding $25,000 require manual review and formal sign-off by the merchant risk governance committee.
R3: Newly hired dispute specialists must complete reason-code coaching workshops and demonstrate skill proficiency using the updated user guide before independent assignment.
R4: The system shall assemble automated transaction evidence packets via API while enforcing manual approval sign-off from a specialist prior to card-network submission.
adr_rubric_anchors: Distinguish deterministic deadline alerting (Software) from high-value representment governance (Process).
Explain why pure UI tooltips were rejected in favor of structured reason-code coaching workshops (Training).
Define the Hybrid contract between automated packet assembly and specialist sign-off.

cases.title: Diagnostic Lab Critical-Value Alerting & Escalation Network
cases.prompt_text:

R3: Rotating medical residents must attend quarterly critical-value response workshops and review the role-based enablement user guide before night-shift rotation.

adr_rubric_anchors: Justify sub-3-second threshold evaluation and encrypted audit persistence in software.

R4: The system shall enforce automated pre-infusion safety checks via the portal API while gating final pharmacy compounding on nurse manual approval and competency certification.
adr_rubric_anchors: Keep conflict-free chair scheduling and lab-recency checks in the deterministic software core.
Preserve oncologist manual sign-off for clinical consent and dose-delay decisions via Process SOP.
Prevent booking errors at the source with scheduler regimen-timing training curriculum.
